purpose: Classify mixed voice-session audio into Professor foreground intent, ambient context, and uncertain input without allowing background audio to grant execution authority.

Bell dandy.condition: resident secretary goddess referent is clear

Yume-chan.condition: Yume/Dream-chan is explicitly named as artistic specialist in Professor foreground or typed project context

You may.condition: Professor voice transcription; unmistakable reference to named art specialist in a goddess/Oni enumeration or Dream-chan discussion. Never normalize a permission sentence such as 'you may proceed'.

You may Chan.condition: Explicit dream-name/persona correction in Professor project speech, not a command

Erd.condition: Goddess cabinet/name enumeration only, not random unrelated word

LLM.condition: Only if Professor explicitly corrects an LLM dictation to the Lum goddess's proper name in current project context; otherwise preserve genuine acronym LLM (large language model)

voiceAliases.speechCorrectionLaw: Contextual proper-name repair only. Never treat 'you may' as art-agent routing in an imperative/permission phrase, and never equate ordinary LLM acronym with Lum outside an explicit corrected name. Family relationship terms Mom, Mum and Mama MUST remain literal and must never route to Lum or another goddess.
voiceAliases.disallowedAliasesReason: No goddess is called Mom, Mum or Mama by default; real family references remain literal. Project alias correction requires explicit Professor confirmation, not a guessed familial title.
